title: SWF: DefineFont and font embedding basics
description: Verify DefineFont2 (tag 48) or DefineFont3 (tag 75) is emitted when the document has a FontItem with exportForActionScript. Check compile.ts for existing font embedding. If missing, add basic DefineFont3 tag with character glyph shapes. Tests: a doc with a font library item compiles to SWF containing tag 75 or tag 48.
